architectureFailureAssessment.impact: New queue delivery pauses. Existing admitted leases and in-flight checkout remain usable, but WAITING tickets may not progress through the Lambda delivery path until SQS recovers.
architectureFailureAssessment.safety: Redis ticket/idempotency state prevents duplicate grants when SQS redelivers duplicate or previously invisible messages.
architectureFailureAssessment.recovery: SQS Standard redelivers unacknowledged messages after visibility timeout; recovery is bounded by visibility/backoff and message retention, not polling.

architectureFailureAssessment.impact: SQS can retain ticket messages, but the Lambda grant consumer stops. Existing admitted buyers can still preview/confirm while new WAITING tickets accumulate.
architectureFailureAssessment.safety: No process-local token fallback is introduced; duplicate invocation remains fenced by Redis ticket state.
architectureFailureAssessment.recovery: Queued messages are retried when Lambda is available again. Expiry/page-leave reapers also call grantWaiting immediately after reclaiming capacity, but cannot replace initial message delivery indefinitely.

architectureFailureAssessment.impact: Admission join/status/token validation, lease accounting and confirmation-slot admission fail closed; Flash Sale checkout availability is interrupted.
architectureFailureAssessment.safety: PostgreSQL remains the durable order/quota authority, so the system does not grant unverified purchases or knowingly oversell.
architectureFailureAssessment.recovery: Automatic Redis cache-loss rebuilding/reconciliation is explicitly deferred in this POC. Redis is therefore the highest-availability-risk dependency.

architectureFailureAssessment.impact: Tickets and leases may still exist in Redis, but order creation and durable quota/claim persistence stop.
architectureFailureAssessment.safety: Checkout fails instead of treating Redis admission as a purchase guarantee; owned provisional attempts are compensated only after a definitive rollback.
architectureFailureAssessment.recovery: Database recovery is outside this POC; idempotency/result lookup must resolve any ambiguous commit before retry compensation.
